dialogues.speaker: Chasm Blasting Team Notice
dialogues.text: "The Chasm has been closed indefinitely. All blasting tools have been sealed within this storehouse. If you do not procure both the two necessary keys simultaneously, this gate will not open."

dialogues.speaker: Chasm Blasting Team Notice
dialogues.text: "The fuses and cannonballs have been placed separately to prevent any accidents from occurring!"
